goalZh: 综合运用本单元的出行用语,用过去时讲一路上的经过
canDoZh: 能和朋友讲一路上的经过:订票、值机、安检、延误和打车,并说出回程要注意什么

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Hey, you guys! You're in LA! How was the trip?
lines.zh: (酒店大堂里,两人等着办入住,和艾米视频)嘿,你们到洛杉矶啦!路上怎么样?

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: At security, I had water in my bag.
lines.zh: 过安检的时候,我包里有水。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Oh no! Lei! No water in your bag!
lines.zh: 哎呀!磊!不是说了包里别放水嘛!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: I forgot! So I drank it all.
lines.zh: 我忘了!所以我一口气全喝了。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: All of it! It was so funny.

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: There was a gate change, and the flight was twenty minutes late.
lines.zh: 换了登机口,飞机还晚了二十分钟。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: But I had the window. The view was beautiful!
lines.zh: 不过我坐靠窗,风景太美了!

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Then we took a car here. The driver was really nice.
lines.zh: 然后我们叫车来的酒店,司机人特别好。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: We're going to see the pier this afternoon!
lines.zh: 我们今天下午去码头看看!

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Cool! On January 8th, be at the airport two hours early.
lines.zh: 不错!1 月 8 号回来那天,也要提前两个小时到机场。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: And don't forget your boarding passes!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Don't worry, Amy. See you on Thursday!

questions.prompt: 磊说的那件好笑的事是什么?
options: 安检时包里有水,他一口气喝完了
questions.explainZh: At security, I had water in my bag. …… I forgot! So I drank it all.

options: 换了登机口,晚了二十分钟
questions.explainZh: There was a gate change, and the flight was twenty minutes late.

questions.prompt: 艾米提醒他们回程那天要注意什么?
options: 提前两小时到机场,别忘了登机牌
questions.explainZh: On January 8th, be at the airport two hours early. And don't forget your boarding passes!

grammar.titleZh: 第 11 单元小结:出行用语
grammar.bodyZh: ① need + 名词 / need to + 动词:I need sunglasses. / You need to be at the airport two hours early.。② 否定祈使句 Don't…:Don't forget your boarding pass! / Don't worry.。③ can / can't 表示规定:You can't have water after security. / You can get up now.。④ 礼貌地问和要:Would you like…? — I'd like…, please.。⑤ How far is it?(多远)和 How long does it take?(多久)。⑥ 讲路上的经过用过去时:There was a gate change. / We took a car.。发音:讲经过时,每件事之间稍微停一下,再用 And… / But… / Then… 接下去。

examples.text: There was a gate change, and the flight was late.
examples.zh: 换了登机口,飞机还晚点了。

examples.text: Then we took a car here. The driver was really nice.
examples.zh: 然后我们叫车来的,司机人特别好。
